description: A laundromat can buy two types of washing machines, a top-loading model and a front-loading model. The top-loading model can wash 50 items per day while the front-loading model can wash 75 items per day. The top-loading model consumes 85 kWh per day while the front-loading model consumes 100 kWh per day. The laundromat must be able to wash at least 5000 items per day and has available 7000 kWh per day. Since the top-loading machine are harder to use, at most 40% of the machines can be top-loading. Further, at least 10 machines should be front-loading. How many of each machine should the laundromat buy to minimize the total number of washing machines?

WashRateTopLoading.definition: Number of items washed per day by a top-loading machine

WashRateFrontLoading.definition: Number of items washed per day by a front-loading machine

EnergyConsumptionTopLoading.definition: Energy consumed per day by a top-loading machine (kWh)

EnergyConsumptionFrontLoading.definition: Energy consumed per day by a front-loading machine (kWh)

MinItemsPerDay.definition: Minimum number of items to wash per day

MaxFractionTopLoading.definition: Maximum fraction of machines that can be top-loading

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of washing machines purchased (top-loading plus front-loading)."

constraints.description: 50 * (number of top-loading machines) + 75 * (number of front-loading machines) >= MinItemsPerDay
constraints.code:
model.addConstr(
    WashRateTopLoading * TopLoadingMachines +
    WashRateFrontLoading * FrontLoadingMachines
    >= MinItemsPerDay
)

constraints.description: 85 * (number of top-loading machines) + 100 * (number of front-loading machines) <= MaxEnergyPerDay
constraints.code:
model.addConstr(
    EnergyConsumptionTopLoading * TopLoadingMachines
    + EnergyConsumptionFrontLoading * FrontLoadingMachines
    <= MaxEnergyPerDay
)

constraints.description: (number of top-loading machines) <= MaxFractionTopLoading * ((number of top-loading machines) + (number of front-loading machines))
Both the number of top-loading machines and the number of front-loading machines must be integers

TopLoadingMachines.definition: Number of top-loading washing machines to purchase

FrontLoadingMachines.definition: Number of front-loading washing machines to purchase
